newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Futuris completes A$150mln note issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Futuris completes A$150mln note issue.

text.p: Manufacturing and rural services group Futuris Corp Ltd said on Thursday it had completed its A$150 million unsecured note issue announced on November 29.

The transaction was arranged and lead managed by SBC Warburg Australia, co-managed by ABN Amro Australia and Commonwealth Bank and provided Futuris with five year and seven year funding, maturing December 15, 2001, and December 15, 2003.
The issue would be used primarily to strengthen the balance sheet of its rural division, Elders Australia Ltd.
Futuris shares closed one cent higher at A$1.72 on turnover of 158,789 shares. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373 1800
